question: decisions.md section 25.10: is a lineage source for the permits whose 10-digit tcad_id no 2026 account prints really not publicly available, and does it matter for the README? Investigated from RO egress, public pages and files only, no login, CAPTCHA or bypass; every capture has a receipt (runtime data/travis/t4-rulings/lineage/receipts.jsonl and the austin-*/receipts.jsonl files)

population.note: every one of them is absent from all 493,324 PROP.TXT records of the 2026 certified export (all account types), except 63 permits whose geo_id a mobile-home account prints

a_tcad.export_layout: Legacy8.0.33 layout (the T1 download): no prior, parent, child, split, merge or history field in any of its record types; the only change marker is the supplemental export sup_action A/M/D (add, modify, delete), which pairs no old with new id

certified_special_export_json.fields_that_bear_on_lineage: links[] (linkID, linkedPID), events[], inactive/reactivate, permits[] (TCAD's own permit records per account: permitNumber in the Austin form, issue and completion dates, status); no prior geo_id field
certified_special_export_json.events: top event types are exemption removals and comments; no split or merge event (follow-up tcad_event_types_top)

land_comment_report_2026.example: "SPLIT OUT OF 787408", "-10.301AC SPLIT INTO 935527 (2019169457) FOR 2020", "DELE/MERGE W/871317": free-text lineage between account ids, written by appraisers

ears_submission_manual.finding: the EARS parent account number (AJR009) groups properties that form one economic unit (a house and the adjacent lot), not a predecessor account

subdivision_condominium_report_2026.finding: lists new subdivisions and condominiums by name and code; no old geo_id

b_tnr_gis.finding: gis.traviscountytx.gov does not answer from RO (connection timeout, as T1 recorded: the host rejects non-US clients); whether the TNR services keep historical or retired parcel layers cannot be checked without US egress

candidates.kk8y-6cmt: Land Database 2021 (one-off, 271,568 rows): pid_10 and prop_id
candidates.6qkk-xgys: Land Use Inventory Detailed of 2022-12-01 (280,889 rows): parcel_id_10 and property_id
candidates.7vsm-dvxg: Land Use Inventory Detailed of 2026-07-05 (284,958 rows): parcel_id_10 and property_id
candidates.it4s-wgjk: Subdivision Review Cases: the case tract tcad_id, not the lots

c_austin.finding: the snapshots print the retired geo_ids beside the account ids they had then (5,873 of the 6,260 in the 2026-07-05 inventory, which is built from older appraisal parcel layers); 5,871 of those account ids are gone from the 2026 roll: they name retired accounts, not current ones

d_point_in_polygon.kit_rule: query-db-loading-matching "Permit/property matching": exact folio or source identity first; normalized parcel or address evidence only as explicit fallbacks; record match method, version, confidence and source hashes; keep unresolved permits unlinked. A permit coordinate is location evidence of the same grade as address evidence: allowed only as an explicit, separately labelled candidate fallback (for example match_method permit_point_in_polygon, confidence candidate), and a property_link method the contract does not list today
d_point_in_polygon.why_so_few: 157,771 of the points fall in no 2026 TNR polygon: the lots carved from these tracts are mostly among the accounts the TNR layer does not draw yet (new lots and condominiums without their own polygon, T1)

tcad_permit_listing.agreement_with_exact_links: 43,378 of 44,546 sampled exact links where TCAD lists one account (97.4%); TCAD lists about 11% of permits

other_candidate_methods.lineage_and_street_line: split children reached through TCAD links, narrowed to one by the permit street line

e_readme_impact.readme_lines: 13 (open, long-open permits), 33 (roof age), 105 and 110 (open roofing permits in an area): the permits are loaded internally and counted under limitations, never shown on a property

conclusion: A lineage exists only between accounts (TCAD JSON links and land comments), keyed to the retired geo_ids through Austin's past snapshots, and for 4,047 of the 4,164 ids it reaches it ends in several current accounts, the lots of a split, so it does not attribute a permit to one parcel. No public source maps most of these permits to one current account: 160,687 of 196,400 (81.8%) are reached by no method at all. TNR historical layers are the one source not checkable from RO.

methods.austin_snapshots: each snapshot's geo_id-like column (pid_10 or parcel_id_10) against the 6,260 retired geo_ids, and the account id beside it against the 2026 seed
methods.land_comments: regular expressions SPLIT OUT OF <id>, SPLIT INTO <id> and MERGE ... <id> over the Comment column; a current account is reached when a comment ties it to an old account id the snapshots print beside the retired geo_id
methods.tcad_json: tar -xOf over the zip (libarchive reads zip64), the top-level array split into accounts and parsed one by one
methods.point_in_polygon: ray casting against the outer ring of each seed polygon (TNR, 2026-10-16), holes excluded, in a 0.005-degree grid
